claims_policy: Explicit targets are compared exactly, including their key set. Main h, Q, fixed graph inputs and first logarithm/inverse targets are transcribed from reviewed source data; higher logarithm coefficients are reproducible regression targets. Sampling targets are transcribed from the reviewed exact sampling computation. There is no update-expected-results CLI.

fixed_input_source_evidence.label: Degree-partition enumeration: separately replayed n=9 extension
Independent refined-color enumeration: n=1 through n=9
One-realizer and marked-context exhaustive enumeration through n=8; original computation shares the earlier refined-color canonicalization primitive

independence: Graph methods derive from two independently authored sources and preserve separate graph construction, canonicalization and root-counting implementations
Sampling fiber counts and marked contexts are freshly implemented in both graph routes; exact t=f*vertex_orbit_size is used
Original sampling scripts share earlier refined graph/rational primitives, so those original computations are not described as an additional independent method
Formal coefficient routes are recursive F(Q)=A construction versus Lagrange inversion and finite-polynomial transfer; both use a common exact rational-series arithmetic layer
The TV product is independently checked by a triangular quotient recurrence; no unknown g7 is supplied
manifest_note: Provenance cannot hash itself; use the enclosing release manifest for its digest. Earlier local intermediate results are excluded from package_files.
publication_safety: Lexical results/ confinement; descriptor-pinned no-follow parent traversal; new .json names only; full temporary write plus fsync and exclusive hard-link publication; no clobber. A renamed pinned directory follows its descriptor. A post-publication directory-fsync failure may leave a complete destination and a failure status.
scope: Exact finite enumeration and formal identities only; no analytic remainder, effective onset, inverse rounding or novelty certification
